subject: Onboarding workshop: SSO/SCIM evidence & least-privilege baseline
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@caretaholdings.com>, security@caretaholdings.com
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding workshop: SSO/SCIM evidence & least-privilege baseline

Hi Elena / Careta security team —

Thanks again for taking the SOC2 intake call earlier. To accelerate the evidence handoff for SSO/SAML and SCIM, wed like to run a short onboarding workshop next Tuesday (30 min) to walk through the artifacts youll share and confirm acceptable redaction patterns. Goal: make the first artifact bundle consumable by our compliance reviewers without multiple back-and-forths.

Proposed agenda (attached):
- Quick goals & timeline (5m)
- SAML assertion samples: what we need (5m)
- SCIM delta & membership snapshot: extraction examples (10m)
- Least-privilege baseline and role mapping: expectations (5m)
- Next steps & delivery method (5m)

Ask before the session: if you can, please bring one SAML assertion sample (CSV export or raw assertion redacted) and one SCIM delta extract (JSON or zipped CSV). If youre uncomfortable sharing raw UPNs or emails, redaction guidelines are in the attached agenda (replace localpart with ******).

Were scheduling a 30-minute block: Tue Jun 22, 11:00-11:30 PT. If that doesnt work, reply with two alternatives and well adjust.

Attachments: workshop-agenda.pdf (agenda + redaction examples)

Thanks —
Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | 415-555-0123

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@caretaholdings.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: security@caretaholdings.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding workshop: SSO/SCIM evidence & least-privilege baseline

Thanks Hannah — Tue 11:00 PT works for us.

Quick question before we meet: our SAML logs live in the IdP (Okta) and our SCIM delta export is currently a nightly job that drops to SFTP. For the sample SAML assertion, is a single redacted XML assertion acceptable, or do you need a CSV with parsed attributes? We can provide both, but wed prefer to limit PII in the initial bundle.

Well attach a small redacted XML assertion to this thread for your review and plan to bring an example SCIM delta (zipped) to the workshop.

—
Elena Torres
Head of IT, Careta Holdings
elena.torres@caretaholdings.com | +1 (206) 555-9876

Attachments: saml-assertion-sample.xml (redacted)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@caretaholdings.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding workshop: SSO/SCIM evidence & least-privilege baseline

Perfect, thanks Elena — looking forward to the workshop. A few pre-reads to make the session more efficient:
- For SAML: a single redacted XML assertion is fine. If you can also provide a small CSV with parsed attributes (nameid, email, groups, authn instant) that speeds verification. Avoid sending full raw logs.
- For SCIM: a delta file (JSON or CSV) showing add/update/remove for 24-48 hours is ideal. If you have a nightly job, a zipped extract of two adjacent nights helps us see the delta lineage.
- Role mapping: if you can include a short mapping doc that maps your Okta groups to your internal role names (CSV is fine), well validate least-privilege gaps against the baseline.

Ive dropped a short checklist and a shared Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example-drive-link — please upload the redacted samples to that folder before the call. Also linking the HubSpot record HS-Deal-4458 so our CSM can reference the intake.

Examples/commands (if your SRE will run exports):
- SCIM delta from Azure AD Graph (example): curl -u $USER:$TOKEN https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/directoryObject/delta > scim-delta-20270621.json
- Okta assertion export: Admin Console > Reports > System Log > Filter: SAML CREATE > Export filtered results (then pick one assertion and redact).

Attachments: (none)

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | 415-555-0189

Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding workshop: SSO/SCIM evidence & least-privilege baseline

Thanks everyone — confirmed for 11:00 PT. Quick note: during the workshop well show the minimal attribute set our auditors need and give a redaction script you can run in-place to scrub identifiable fields. If anyone on your side prefers a synchronous screen-share extraction instead of uploading artifacts, say so and well reserve extra time.

See you Tuesday —
Sean Gallagher
Director, Compliance & Security | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | 415-555-0147
